results.claim: eq. (6) is a strict Lyapunov function of super-twisting at (3/2, 11/10) for every measurable |delta| <= 1; the exact check accepts one V witness and two W witnesses per orthant, largest residual ||E||_1 below 4e-7 eps; Gram sizes 7 (V) and 6 (W), parity blocks 4+3 and 3+3
order one exact in finite time at (1.1, 1.5) for every L > 0

results.where: Theorem 2, k = 2, last sentence; Table 2 row k = 2 all tunings between; Figure 3

results.where: Theorem 2, k = 3, tunings a and b; Table 2 rows k = 3

results.where: Section 6.2, Order four; Table 2 row k = 4
results.claim: without disturbance, a function of degree 11 that uses all 507 terms of the library is certified at tuning a
results.kind: certificate (VERIFIED on the authors' workstation, 10 h 17 min; not re-run here) + Lemma 3 and Corollary 1 (every L, polynomial signals of degree at most four)

results.where: Section 7.1, eq. (13); Proposition 4; Table 2 row Twisting

results.where: Section 7.2; Table 2 row Continuous twisting delta0 = 1; Appendix B
